name: updateDeliverableStatus
shortDescription: Changes the status of an existing deliverable (e.g., submitted, approved, rejected), updating its progression.
description:
Overview

Modifies the status of an existing Deliverable record.

Intended use

Called by Lead Points or Stumps from the Responsibility and Deliverable Management UI, or by an AI agent, to update the status of a deliverable. Parameters include deliverableId and newStatus.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the Deliverable record using params.deliverableId via ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  2. Verify that the ctx.user_id matches the idOfUser on the Deliverable record, or that the user has the leadPoint or admin role. If not, return an unauthorized error.
  3. Validate params.newStatus against allowed Deliverable.status enum values. If invalid, return an error.
  4. Update the Deliverable record's status attribute using ctx.data.update.
  5. If newStatus is 'approved', set completedAt to the current timestamp.
  6. Audit-log the deliverable status update using ctx.audit.log, including the deliverable ID and new status.
  7. Return the updated Deliverable record.

Entities

  • Deliverable
